scope: Incremental contracts in five existing Codex crates; ordinary Rust behavior unchanged.

contracts.property: UTF-8 prefix bounded by both the byte budget and input; returns the original text when it fits.
Retry implies attempt < max_attempts and at least one retry policy flag enabled.
contracts.blocker: Missing panic models for http::StatusCode::as_u16 and is_server_error.

contracts.property: Successful catalog length is at most the default or supplied item limit.
contracts.blocker: Async opaque-sort environment mismatch in Flux; wrapper interrupted and limited collector body not reached.

contracts.property: Costs never decrease; successful write reports the exact input length and saturates the counter; flush preserves the counter.
Constructor records transcript length; insertion requires an index below that length. Mutable helpers preserve that length.
contracts.remaining: Mutation helper bodies and callers are not verified. The broader profile check reports VecDeque, index and arithmetic obligations and then crashes in type_env.rs. Helper bodies were not reached after adding their signatures.

contracts.property: At most three undecoded bytes remain between calls; constructor starts with zero.
contracts.blocker: Missing UTF-8 decoder and Vec mutation facts; push_bytes and finish do not establish the invariant.

runtime.command: just test -p codex-utils-string -p codex-utils-stream-parser -p codex-client -p codex-guardian-context -p codex-mcp
runtime.note: Run through the pinned Flux Nix shell with just, cargo-nextest, uv, dotslash and patchelf. Later edits only adjust cfg(flux) annotations.

rejected: Reset text_bytes to zero in add_content
Do not increment ByteCount in write
Reset ByteCount to zero in flush
negative_controls.restoration: Original budget.rs restored in finally; all three original bodies accepted in codex-contract-guardian-restored.

validation.proof_scope: Targeted bodies only, strict overflow and no-panic enabled. Unselected functions and external models are assumptions; dependency proof closure is not collected. No whole-crate or whole-Codex verification claim.
validation.performance: Individual body times, solver times and Cargo elapsed times are in the archived reports. These are single observations, not comparative benchmarks.

reproduce: At the pinned Flux commit, run tools/codex/corpus.py check with --source pointing to a prepared clone of this branch, --flux pointing to the built Flux checkout, and the packages/only_check filters from the corresponding archived report.json. Use a new --output directory for each run; --timeout 90 --offline. No further Flux changes are required.

evidence.contents: JSON mapping each run to reports, exact source patches, per-function maps, diagnostics and available timings.

next_obligations: Propagate retention index bounds through EntryPool and its callers; relate token totals to retained entries.
Discharge retry HTTP status panic obligations without weakening the retry limit.
Establish UTF-8 rollback and remainder bounds with decoder and Vec models.
Resume pagination length proof after the async checker blocker.
